conclusion: ants_v2_diverse_e01 strongly improves external/public-domain generalization but is not a drop-in replacement for ants_v1 because it materially regresses on the original ant2/own-colony domain, especially large queen scale and local visual distractors.

externalBenchmarkSummary.note: Center metrics are diagnostic localization metrics, not substitutes for standard mAP.

likelyDrivers: Scale gap: ant2 median normalized bbox area is about 13.6x ants_v2 TRAIN median area.
Class/domain gap: ant2 includes a large queen, large workers, brood, food, cotton, reflections and close-up plastic/acrylic artifacts absent or underrepresented in v2 TRAIN.
Density distribution differs: ant2 has fewer ants per frame but larger objects; v2 TRAIN often has many small ants and crowded public outdoor scenes.
The v2 model learned much better public-domain small/mixed ants but did not preserve own-colony close-up performance.
designImplicationForV3: Use mixed-scale training: retain public TRAIN for generalization, add a small own-colony positive pack for queen/large-worker scale, and add verified hard negatives for nest materials and glare.
